form.introBody: Save this location, then use Connect to grant account consent. McHarbor stores the returned tokens encrypted.

tenant_id.label: Tenant ID
tenant_id.help: Microsoft Entra tenant ID (GUID). From Entra admin center > Overview. The OAuth consent flow redirects to login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant_id}/…

client_id.label: Client ID
client_id.help: Application (client) ID of the Entra app registration with Files.ReadWrite and Sites.ReadWrite delegated permissions and a Web redirect URI pointing at this McHarbor host.

client_secret.label: Client Secret
client_secret.help: Client secret value from Entra admin center → App registrations → Certificates & secrets. Stored encrypted at rest.

drive_id.label: Drive ID
drive_id.help: Optional. Fully-qualified Graph drive identifier. Leave blank to use the site's default document library (resolved via Site ID).

base_path.label: Base Path
base_path.help: Optional. Graph path inside the drive, e.g. /Backups/2026. Leave blank to use the drive root. Not prefilled on purpose.

site_id.label: SharePoint Site ID
site_id.help: Graph site ID, e.g. contoso.sharepoint.com,guid1,guid2. Required when Drive ID is blank. From /sites/{hostname}:/sites/{path} in Graph Explorer.

setup.title: SharePoint Online setup guide
setup.step1: In the Microsoft Entra admin center, open App registrations > New registration. Pick Accounts in this organizational directory only as the supported account type and copy the Tenant ID from the Overview page — paste it into the Tenant ID field on the left.
setup.step2: Under Certificates & secrets, create a new client secret. Copy the Value (not the Secret ID) — paste it into the Client Secret field on the left. Copy the Application (client) ID into the Client ID field.
setup.step3: Grant the app the Files.ReadWrite.All, Sites.ReadWrite.All, and User.Read application permissions (admin consent required). The OAuth flow will request offline_access on the operator's behalf.
setup.step4: Set the SharePoint Site ID to the Graph site identifier (e.g. contoso.sharepoint.com,guid1,guid2). Leave blank if you specify a Drive ID instead — Drive ID takes precedence when both are present.
setup.step5: Leave Base Path blank for the drive root, or enter an explicit Graph path like /Backups/2026. The form does not prefill a default.
setup.step6: Click Save and connect (or Connect on the storage card). Microsoft will ask you to sign in and grant the requested scopes. McHarbor stores the returned refresh token encrypted and never shows it again.
setup.step7: Click Test connection to round-trip a probe object in the chosen document library.

page.title: SharePoint Online Backup Destinations
page.subtitle: Back up containers to SharePoint document libraries under a work/school tenant. The plugin handles Test, Upload, Download, Delete, and List at backup time. Large backups use Microsoft's chunked upload session so there is no size cap.
page.registerHint: Add a destination from the host's Storage Locations page and pick "SharePoint" as the type.

fields.refreshToken: Refresh token (delivered by the OAuth consent flow)
fields.driveId: Drive ID (leave empty to use the site's default document library)

help.clientId: Register an app at https://entra.microsoft.com → App registrations. The app must have Files.ReadWrite.All, Sites.ReadWrite.All, and User.Read delegated permissions.
help.clientSecret: Generate a client secret in the Azure AD app registration. It is encrypted at rest by the host's AES-256-GCM service.
help.refreshToken: After saving the destination, click "Save and connect" to complete the Microsoft consent flow and store a long-lived refresh token.
help.tenantId: Find your tenant ID at https://entra.microsoft.com → Tenant properties.
help.siteId: Graph site identifier, e.g. contoso.sharepoint.com,guid1,guid2. Required when Drive ID is blank.
help.driveId: Optional. Leave empty to target the site's default document library via /sites/{site_id}/drive.

error.noClientId: Azure AD application (client) ID is required.
error.noClientSecret: Azure AD client secret is required.
error.noRefreshToken: Refresh token is required. Run "Save and connect" first.
error.noTenantId: Azure AD tenant ID is required for SharePoint Online destinations.
error.noSiteId: SharePoint site ID or Drive ID is required for SharePoint Online destinations.
